publications.name: Audio-Visual Dog Identification and Tracking in Real-World Videos
publications.summary: A multimodal dog-fingerprinting framework that combines visual identification, multi-object tracking, and vocal fingerprinting to attribute barks to individual dogs in real-world videos, with a benchmark of 46 videos and 213 annotated bark events.

publications.name: A Preview of Computational Animal Linguistics
publications.summary: A survey of computational animal linguistics: the study of non-human animal vocal communication as a language system using data-driven methods from NLP and large language modeling.

publications.name: Unsupervised Discovery and Analysis of the Vocal Repertoires and Patterns of Select Corvid Species
publications.summary: Unsupervised discovery and acoustic analysis of the vocal repertoires and call patterns of select corvid species.

publications.name: DogSpeak: A Canine Vocalization Classification Dataset
publications.summary: A large-scale in-the-wild dataset of 77,202 bark sequences (33 hours) from 156 dogs of 5 breeds with dog ID, sex, and breed labels, with benchmarks for sex, breed, and individual recognition.

publications.name: EmotionalCanines: A Dataset for Analysis of Arousal and Valence in Dog Vocalization
publications.summary: A framework for collecting reliable arousal and valence labels at scale, producing a dataset of 1,400 Husky and Shiba Inu bark sequences labeled for emotional state.

publications.name: A Data-driven Approach to the Longitudinal Study of Canine Vocal Pattern Development
publications.summary: The Canine Age Transition Vocalization Dataset of 125 dogs across 6 breeds with verified birthdates, and a longitudinal analysis of how bark types and acoustic units change as dogs mature.

publications.name: Toward Automatic Discovery of a Canine Phonetic Alphabet
publications.summary: Outstanding Paper Award. An iterative algorithm inspired by human phonetic discovery, based on minimal pairs, that produces a complete alphabet of canine phoneme-like units and recurring acoustic units tied to dogs' environments and activities.

publications.name: Phonetic and Lexical Discovery of Canine Vocalization
publications.summary: A data-driven approach using self-supervised HuBERT to classify canine phones and adaptive grammar induction to identify a preliminary vocabulary, some of whose words show causal relations with dog activities.

publications.name: Phonetic and Lexical Discovery of a Canine Language using HuBERT
publications.summary: A self-supervised HuBERT approach to classify phoneme labels in dog vocalizations and identify a rudimentary vocabulary, with a web-based labeling system that highlights phoneme n-grams in uploaded dog audio.
